content.json:
# LLM Judge: 評価結果とトークン利用量
プロジェクト別に、方式（固定モデル / HydraFusion など）の評価スコア・合格率・コスト・トークン利用量を比較します。

parameters.name: project
parameters.label: プロジェクト
parameters.query: customEvents | where name startswith "LlmJudge" | distinct tostring(customDimensions.project)

items.name: 方式ごとの平均総合点（0〜100）

content.title: 方式ごとの平均総合点（0〜100）
content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "LlmJudgeRun"
| where tostring(customDimensions.project) in ({project})
| extend project = tostring(customDimensions.project), variant = tostring(customDimensions.variant),
         task_id = tostring(customDimensions.task_id), run_id = tostring(customDimensions.run_id),
         eval_id = tostring(customDimensions.eval_id)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by eval_id, run_id
| summarize avg_total = round(avg(todouble(customMeasurements.total)), 1), runs = count() by project, variant
| order by project asc, avg_total desc

items.name: 方式ごとの観点別スコア（中央値の平均、0〜5）

content.title: 方式ごとの観点別スコア（中央値の平均、0〜5）
content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "LlmJudgeRun"
| where tostring(customDimensions.project) in ({project})
| extend project = tostring(customDimensions.project), variant = tostring(customDimensions.variant),
         task_id = tostring(customDimensions.task_id), run_id = tostring(customDimensions.run_id),
         eval_id = tostring(customDimensions.eval_id)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by eval_id, run_id
| extend m = customMeasurements
| summarize requirements = avg(todouble(m["scores.requirements"])), test_quality = avg(todouble(m["scores.test_quality"])),
            robustness = avg(todouble(m["scores.robustness"])), design = avg(todouble(m["scores.design"])),
            maintainability = avg(todouble(m["scores.maintainability"])), change_scope = avg(todouble(m["scores.change_scope"])),
            explanation = avg(todouble(m["scores.explanation"])) by project, variant

items.name: Hard Gate 合格率と 1 試行あたりのコスト（不合格の試行を含む）

content.title: Hard Gate 合格率と 1 試行あたりのコスト（不合格の試行を含む）
content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "LlmJudgeAttempt"
| where tostring(customDimensions.project) in ({project})
| extend project = tostring(customDimensions.project), variant = tostring(customDimensions.variant),
         run_id = tostring(customDimensions.run_id), hard_gate = tostring(customDimensions.hard_gate)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by run_id
| summarize attempts = count(), pass_rate = round(countif(hard_gate == "pass") * 1.0 / count(), 2),
            avg_cost_usd = round(avg(todouble(customMeasurements.cost_usd)), 3),
            avg_tokens_in = round(avg(todouble(customMeasurements.tokens_in))), avg_tokens_out = round(avg(todouble(customMeasurements.tokens_out))),
            avg_duration_sec = round(avg(todouble(customMeasurements.duration_sec)))
  by project, variant

items.name: 機械的な指標の差分（Δ の平均）

content.title: 機械的な指標の差分（Δ の平均）
content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "LlmJudgeAttempt"
| where tostring(customDimensions.project) in ({project})
| extend project = tostring(customDimensions.project), variant = tostring(customDimensions.variant),
         run_id = tostring(customDimensions.run_id), hard_gate = tostring(customDimensions.hard_gate)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by run_id
| extend m = customMeasurements
| summarize dV = avg(todouble(m["metrics_delta.complexity_total"])), dup_lines = avg(todouble(m["metrics_delta.duplicated_lines"])),
            coupling_edges = avg(todouble(m["metrics_delta.coupling_edges"])), dPC = avg(todouble(m["metrics_delta.propagation_cost"])),
            dQ = avg(todouble(m["metrics_delta.modularity"])) by project, variant

content.json: ## トークン利用量（APIM の計測）

items.name: 方式ごとのトークン利用量

content.title: 方式ごとのトークン利用量
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Total Tokens")
| where tostring(customDimensions.project) in ({project})
| extend variant = tostring(customDimensions.variant), project = tostring(customDimensions.project)
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by project, variant, name

items.name: トークン利用量の推移

content.title: トークン利用量の推移
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| where tostring(customDimensions.project) in ({project})
| extend variant = tostring(customDimensions.variant)
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1d), variant

items.name: 人間レビューに回す Run

content.title: 人間レビューに回す Run / ペア（未レビューを先頭に表示）
content.query:
let human = customEvents
| where name == "LlmJudgeHumanReview"
| where tostring(customDimensions.project) in ({project})
| extend project = tostring(customDimensions.project), review_key = tostring(customDimensions.review_key)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by project, review_key
| project project, review_key, human_reviewed_at = timestamp,
          human_decision = tostring(customDimensions.decision), human_comment = tostring(customDimensions.comment);
customEvents
| where name in ("LlmJudgeRun", "LlmJudgePair")
| where tostring(customDimensions.project) in ({project})
| extend project = tostring(customDimensions.project), eval_id = tostring(customDimensions.eval_id),
         review_id = iff(name == "LlmJudgePair", tostring(customDimensions.pair_id), tostring(customDimensions.run_id))
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by project, eval_id, name, review_id
| where todouble(customMeasurements["human_review.count"]) > 0
| extend review_key = iff(name == "LlmJudgePair", strcat(eval_id, ":", review_id), review_id)
| join kind=leftouter human on project, review_key
| extend run_ids = iff(name == "LlmJudgePair", pack_array(customDimensions.run_a, customDimensions.run_b), pack_array(customDimensions.run_id))
| mv-expand run_id = run_ids to typeof(string)
| extend variant = iff(name == "LlmJudgePair", iff(run_id == tostring(customDimensions.run_a), tostring(customDimensions.variant_a), tostring(customDimensions.variant_b)), tostring(customDimensions.variant))
| extend status = iff(isnull(human_reviewed_at), "未レビュー", "レビュー済み")
| project timestamp, status, project, task_id = tostring(customDimensions.task_id), eval_id, review_id, variant, run_id,
          total = todouble(customMeasurements.total), confidence = tostring(customDimensions.confidence),
          reasons = tostring(customDimensions.human_review), human_decision, human_comment, human_reviewed_at
| order by status desc, timestamp desc

items.name: Run ごとのトークン利用量（実行基盤）

content.title: Run ごとのトークン利用量（未計測は空欄）
content.query:
customEvents
| where name == "LlmJudgeAttempt"
| where tostring(customDimensions.project) in ({project})
| extend project = tostring(customDimensions.project), run_id = tostring(customDimensions.run_id)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by project, run_id
| project timestamp, project, variant = tostring(customDimensions.variant), run_id,
          tokens_in = todouble(customMeasurements.tokens_in), tokens_out = todouble(customMeasurements.tokens_out),
          cost_usd = todouble(customMeasurements.cost_usd)
| order by timestamp desc
